`.template { }` at ServiceRole.kt:59 is attached to "src/main/kotlin/com/example/service/*Service.kt" of role "domain.Service", whose path still holds an unnamed wildcard.
Generating a file needs a value for every level the path leaves open, and an unnamed * or **, or a ?, [...] or {...}, has no --arg name for that value to arrive as.
Name every remaining * with capture("..."), such as "${capture("name")}Repository.kt".file(), and write ?, [...] and {...} out as the name the file will have.
